_comment: CARIBOU v1.0 SHORT sleeve — cross-asset trend fund (managed futures / CTA). Scans a maximally diversified universe across EVERY asset class on Hyperliquid (crypto, xyz stocks, indices, metals, energy) and opens SHORTS on assets in a confirmed DOWNTREND (4h structure bearish is the hard gate; daily aligns; 24h momentum + RSI capitulation guard refine). Time-series trend (each asset vs its own history), NOT cross-sectional. Positions are sized to EQUAL RISK via volatility parity (margin scales inversely with the asset's ATR%, normalized to referenceVolPct, clamped) and capped per asset CLASS so the book can never collapse into one class. This sleeve is the crisis-alpha engine — it shorts the fallers across every class when markets break. Pairs with the LONG sleeve (caribou-long-config.json) on a SEPARATE wallet — the two sleeves are independent so the fund CAN hold the same asset long in one and short in the other. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, the asymmetric trend DSL (cut losers fast, let winners run, time-cuts off) via runtime-short.yaml. Producer launched with CARIBOU_LEG=short.
_sizing_note: VOLATILITY PARITY: margin = account_value * baseRiskPct * (referenceVolPct / asset_ATR%), clamped to [minMarginPct, maxMarginPct] of equity. A calm index gets more margin; a wild name gets less — each position contributes ~equal risk. Leverage is baseLeverage, bumped to maxLeverage on an apexScore trend, then clamped to the asset's HL venue max. Nothing here is a hardcoded $ amount.
_class_cap_note: classMarginCapPct caps total deployed margin in any ONE asset class at 40% of equity, so the book stays diversified across classes. maxSlots 8 = a diversified book.
_persona: Cross-asset trend-follower (managed futures) — SHORT sleeve, the crisis-alpha engine. Follows confirmed downtrends across all of Hyperliquid, vol-parity sized, class-capped, let-winners-run DSL. One of two sleeves of the Caribou cross-asset trend fund; pairs with the long sleeve on a separate wallet.
